messages:
jia: Quick ask — can someone kick off a profiling + smoke bench for INT4+FP8 combo on canary-2? Trying to validate the throughput win and check tail regressed after the kernel tweak.

mike: sure. which model + promptset? also do you want KV warmup enabled for the run?

jia: model: rwd-7b-archv2, promptset: small-instr-2 (500 samples). yes include KV warmup (seq len 512). want both cold and warmed runs.

anya: I can run the regression harness later today. use `benchctl run --model rwd-7b-archv2 --quant int4,fp8 --prompts small-instr-2 --kv-warm true --out s3://redwood-qa/quant/2176`

sam: FYI I've seen a tail spike when batch size > 8 after the last kernel patch — looked like garbage collect-ish pause in the runtime. leaving a short log snippet: `2026-03-17T12:02:03Z runtime: kv_cache_miss_cleanup took 132ms`

mike: tagging @sam to run the microprof with `--trace kvcache,alloc` so we can see where the 132ms comes from. canary-2 has the new kernel deployed.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: canary-2 updated to rwd-runtime@sha256:7a1f... (deployed by ci/pipeline-quant).

lee: quick code-review ping — PR 3421 (quant/kernel-warmup) is linked to this change. @anya please add perf diffs to the PR so we can gate.

anya: will do. I'll attach a csv with med/p95/p99 and token/sec. wanted to confirm acceptance criteria: if p99 increase <= 10ms and token/sec improves >= 6% we promote?

mike: sounds reasonable as a starting point. also require no regressions in top-10 prompts by semantic similarity (eval harness).

jia: agreed. also watch sampling stability (nucleus sampling) — earlier INT4 runs showed small coherence drops at long tails. add a tiny eval: 50 shots long-form.

sam: starting microprof now. will run: `benchctl profile --model rwd-7b-archv2 --quant int4,fp8 --bsize 12 --trace kvcache,alloc --out /tmp/2176-trace.json` and upload results.

anya: kicked off regression bench, ETA ~45m. I'll post a summary table when finished.

sam: quick update — trace shows repeated 20-30ms stalls in `kv_migrate()` during first 200 tokens for bsize>8. could be allocator contention.

mike: can you capture the perf map (flame) and add to the PR? that will help kernel folks.

sam: uploaded flame at s3://redwood-qa/quant/2176/flame.html. linking to PR 3421.

anya: regression results: median latency down 4%, token/sec up 7.8%, p99 up +12ms. semantic eval: micro-drop on 3/50 long-form samples (scored -0.02). attaching csv: s3://redwood-qa/quant/2176/regression.csv

lee: given p99 > 10ms threshold, we should hold the canary. but the throughput gains are nice. propose a controlled rollback for canary-2 and re-run with allocator patch candidate in PR 3430.

jia: agree with hold. can we try a hotfix that changes KV allocator to reduce contention and rerun? if that cuts p99 by >=6ms we re-evaluate.

mike: assigning follow-up: @sam to validate allocator patch on canary-2, @anya to re-run regression after patch. I'll create a short checklist in the PR for gating.

sam: ack — I'll try the allocator patch and post back results (should be quick).

anya: thanks team — will keep this thread updated with regression metrics. :thumbsup:

jia: perfect. tagging this as async-check — we can reconvene if results show improvement. Thanks all.
